authority.execution_contract: implemented=true describes a GPUWM runtime component; profile and maturity labels never substitute for runtime validation
authority.parameter_declaration: parameters declare every knob a GPUWM runtime component reads; implemented=false publishes a knob GPUWM does not yet honor so the registry doubles as the porting roadmap, and such a knob can never be set. Component selector_keys are declared on their component and are deliberately absent from parameters.
authority.per_domain_override_semantics: templates.per_domain_overrides is indexed by depth below the tree root and carries values transcribed from verified runs; nominal_dx_m is provenance for display and is never a resolved setting.
authority.reachability_declaration: components.<component>.options.<option>.reachability declares how a user can select the option: 'template' through a registered base template, 'component-override' only as a per-domain component override on a route that allows it, 'expert-template' only through a route's expert_template_ids with its expert_acknowledgement_id, and 'unreachable' not at all -- which must name a blocker. implemented and reachable are independent properties and the intended pairing is declared here rather than assumed: an option that is not implemented must be unreachable, and an implemented one that is unreachable must say what stops it. tests/test_registry_reachability.py recomputes every state from the templates and routes and fails on a difference.

admitted_surface_layers.gpuwm_evidence: gpuwm/core/mynn_surface.py MYNN_SURFACE_OUTPUTS carries chs, chs2, cqs2, cpm, flhc, flqc, qgh, qsfc and ch, which is the whole set gpuwm/core/physics.py _run_noah reads off the surface layer, and the standing 5/5 runtime gate forecasts this exact pair for 300 steps (tests/test_mynn_pbl_runtime.py:49).
admitted_surface_layers.removed_constraint: requires_components.surface_layer was [revised-mm5, classic-mm5] and was WRONG: it made the registry refuse component-dependency on the one configuration MYNN's own warning cites as its evidence, while gpuwm/config.py validate_run_config accepted it. tests/test_authority_agreement.py now fails on any such disagreement.
admitted_surface_layers.wrf_authority: share/module_check_a_mundo.F carries no sf_sfclay_physics constraint for sf_surface_physics=2 -- its only surface-layer/PBL pairing errors are the TEMF 10/10 pair -- and phys/module_surface_driver.F:2386-2390 hands SFCLAY_mynn the same chs/chs2/cqs2/cpm/flhc/flqc/qgh/qsfc exchange coefficients CASE (LSMSCHEME) consumes.

noah.label: Four-layer Noah LSM
warnings: NOAH IS NOW MEASURED AGAINST WRF AND IT IS NOT BITWISE. tools/noah_wrf461_oracle/build.sh drives the byte-unmodified phys/module_sf_noahdrv.F subroutine lsm -- the exact scope kernels/noah.cu transcribes, prep and post-update included -- over 42 land columns, and tests/test_noah_wrf461_parity.py pins the result. ESTABLISHED: seven of the 31 driver outputs are bit-identical to WRF on every column of all four switch fixtures (albbck, emiss, z0, snotime, acsnow, chklowq and the whole TSLB soil-temperature profile); TSK is within 2 ULP, LH/QSFC/ALBEDO 3, QFX/POTEVP 5, SNOWC/CANWAT 8, SNOWH 9, SNOW 10, GRDFLX 170, HFX 375. NOT ESTABLISHED: no gpuwm/WRF forecast-trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, which is what validation-candidate would require, and four divergence populations below are open.

OPEN 1, FROZEN-GROUND INFILTRATION. On the three fixture columns that are simultaneously frozen and melting snow, SFCRUNOFF is 6.06e7 ULP from WRF (8.5e-05 mm against 4.9e-03 mm over a 60 s step) and SH2O is 6508 ULP. SRT (module_sf_noahlsm.F:3792-3806) scales the infiltration limit by FCR, an expf of a powf series in CVFRZ*FRZX/DICE, then forms RUNOFF1 = PCPDRP - INFMAX between two nearly equal quantities. The transcription is faithful line for line; what differs is CUDA's expf/powf against glibc's, amplified by that split. The water is redistributed, not lost: the 4.85e-03 mm runoff gap is the same water as the 4.85e-05 volumetric SH2O gap. Closing it needs the gpuwm/core/noahmp_libm.py treatment applied to the device transcendentals Noah reaches.

OPEN 2, A SUBNORMAL SNOW DEPTH TAKES THE WRONG BRANCH. CuPy appends -ftz=true unconditionally, so where WRF's IF(SNOW(I,J).GT.0.0) is true for the smallest positive float32 subnormal and the column takes the ice-saturation Q2SAT/DQSDT2 blend, the kernel's snow > 0.0f is false and it takes the snow-free arm: 0.083 K in TSK, 1.95 W/m2 in HFX, 2.87 W/m2 in LH. Fixture case 18. This is a branch disagreement on an unphysical input, not an error in the physics, but it is the fourth instance of the -ftz class in this project.

OPEN 3, THE ENERGY RESIDUAL IS A DIFFERENT FUNCTION. NOAHRES is accumulated in float64 and rounded once by kernels/noah.cu where module_sf_noahdrv.F:1308 accumulates it in float32. The sum cancels terms of order 500 W/m2 into a residual of order 0.01, so WRF's value carries only its low bits and is quantised to ~3e-05. gpuwm's number is the more accurate one and it is not WRF's. NOAHRES is diagnostic and feeds no prognostic variable.

OPEN 4, SFLX_GLACIAL IS NOT PORTED, and the cost is now measured rather than merely named. On a land-ice column (ivgtyp == isice) noah_column returns without touching the state while WRF runs module_sf_noahlsm_glacial_only.F: after one 60 s step TSK is 255.0 against 273.15 K, HFX 0 against 388.9 W/m2, LH 0 against -319.1 W/m2, GRDFLX 0 against -42.2 W/m2 and SH2O 0.28 against 1.0. The bundle's d01 has no land-ice points (pinned in tests/test_noah.py); any domain that does must not use this scheme.

WHAT THE ORACLE FOUND ON ITS FIRST RUN, and what that says about the previous evidence: CHKLOWQ was 0 instead of 1 on open-water and sea-ice columns, because module_sf_noahdrv.F writes it for every column at :809-814 before the XLAND branch while noah_column returned from its three skip paths without writing it. CHKLOWQ multiplies the moisture flux at the surface-layer seam. Thirty-seven self-consistency tests could not see it: gpuwm.verify.npref.np_noah_column already had it right, so the CUDA-versus-mirror sweeps never compared the field on a skipped column. Fixed; that field is now bit-identical on every column.

The parameter tables carry their own separate evidence: gpuwm/data/noah_tables VEGPARM.TBL, SOILPARM.TBL and GENPARM.TBL are byte-identical to WRF v4.6.1's run/ directory (tests/test_noah.py::test_shipped_tables_byte_identical_to_wrf_run_dir), and the oracle harness reads them through WRF's own SOIL_VEG_GEN_PARM, so the fixture also checks gpuwm's transcription of that list-directed READ sequence rather than assuming it.

noah-mp.label: Noah-MP land-surface model
warnings: Noah-MP RUNS and is UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. Every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_noahmplsm.F and NOAHMP_SFLX is bitwise on all four whole-column fixtures, but no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists for this scheme, which is what validation-candidate would require. tests/test_noahmp_runtime.py is the standing runtime gate.

The whole column runs on the DEVICE: the slab orchestration (gpuwm/core/noahmp_column_slab.py) answers every land column with no Python per column, in chunks of SLAB_COLUMN_CHUNK (65,536), and is bitwise -- max ULP 0 -- against the scalar column authority on twelve heterogeneous fixture columns field by field, at a full 65,536-column chunk, and end to end at 360,000 columns. Measured 2026-07-27, twice, on one RTX 5090: a 360,000-land-column call costs 0.202-0.227 s through the slab path, i.e. 7.3-8.2 wall seconds per simulated minute at dt=1.667 s with bldt=0, against 4,982-5,977 through the retired per-column CPython solver this warning used to describe (97% interpreter time, 6.4 ms per land column, flat). Absolute seconds are a property of the machine; this box varies up to 30% between harnesses and hours. The staged per-column path remains the paired second implementation (GPUWM_NOAHMP_STAGED_COLUMNS=1) and GPUWM_NOAHMP_HOST_LEAVES=1 still selects the CPython leaves on it. The scaling blocker this warning used to record is RETIRED.
GLACIER columns are REFUSED, not run: a column whose VEGTYP equals ISICE_TABLE raises, because module_sf_noahmp_glacier.F (3,080 lines) is not ported and NOAHMP_SFLX is not a substitute for it.

SEA-ICE columns (XICE >= 0.5) take WRF's own skip, so a Noah-MP run has no sea-ice surface energy balance: TSK/HFX/QFX over sea ice keep whatever the surface layer left. XICE_THRESHOLD is pinned at WRF's Registry default 0.5 and is not configurable.

The PRECIPITATION PARTITION is coarser than WRF's. WRF's surface driver passes six separate MP_* rates to noahmplsm; gpuwm's land-surface seam carries only RAINBL and SR, so the runner takes noahmplsm's other branch: PRCPNONC = RAINBL/DT, PRCPSNOW = SR*RAINBL/DT, and the convective, shallow-convective, graupel and hail rates are zero. Under opt_snf=1 the rain/snow phase still comes from SFCTMP, so the visible consequence is in the convective/large-scale split feeding canopy interception.

COSZ is evaluated at the SURFACE-CALL time from the domain's solar geometry. WRF hands noahmplsm the COSZEN the radiation driver last wrote, which carries radconst's half-radiation-interval offset and is stale between radiation calls; the divergence is bounded by radt/2 plus the time since the last radiation call. A Noah-MP run must bind a start time and a latitude/longitude grid explicitly -- there is no default.

26 of NOAHMP_SFLX's roughly 120 outputs are stored and written (gpuwm/core/noahmp_runtime.py NOAHMP_DIAGNOSTICS_2D). The rest are computed and discarded rather than zero-filled. WRF's module_diag_misc.F output accumulators have no gpuwm counterpart at all, so noahmp_output and noahmp_acc_dt change nothing.

Four WRF Registry restart carriers are MEASURED INERT over one step under this identity: a +5 K TAHXY, a 50%-larger CHXY or CMXY and a +0.3 FWETXY all leave the next step bit identical, because TAH/CH/CM are re-derived by converging iterations in VEGE_FLUX/SFCDIF1 and FWET is unconditionally reassigned by PRECIP_HEAT.

Admitted with the MM5 surface layer only. Pairing Noah-MP with the MYNN surface layer (sf_sfclay_physics=5) has not been measured and is refused: MYNN diagnoses T2/Q2/TH2 itself and supplies UST/HFX/QFX, all of which Noah-MP also writes.

The pinned option identity is the exact WRF Registry default; opt_crop, opt_irr, opt_irrm, opt_infdv and opt_tdrn are admitted at 0 only, and num_soil_layers at 4 only. No other value of any Noah-MP knob has been measured -- not approximated, not measured.

reachability.blocker: No registered template selects sf_surface_physics=0 and no route lists land_surface in allowed_component_overrides. A land-surface-free configuration remains available to the in-process API (gpuwm.core.physics.initialize_physics) and is what the idealized dycore tests run; it is deliberately not offered to a source-driven forecast, where every registered source supplies a soil state and dropping the LSM would leave TSK frozen at the analysis value.

ruc-lsm.label: RUC land-surface model
warnings: RUC RUNS and is UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. Every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_ruclsm.F and the assembled driver is bitwise against oracle/lsmruc.csv except its 26 pinned upstream-residue cells, but no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists, which is what validation-candidate would require. tests/test_ruc_runtime.py is the standing runtime gate; docs/wrf_ruc_runtime_admission.md is the record.

THE COLUMN RUNS ON THE CARD, and the wall clock is measured at production width rather than extrapolated from a narrow grid. gpuwm/core/ruc_runtime.py ruc_lsm_step passes the CUDA leaf set, the CUDA snow-preparation stage and the CuPy array namespace into gpuwm/core/ruc.py ruc_land_surface_step, so LSMRUC's prologue, the sfctmp dispatch's masking and mosaic recombination, the four leaves and the epilogue are all device work and the surface slab never leaves the card. On an RTX 5090 at d04's 360,000 columns with dt=1.667 s and bldt=0: 16.8 wall seconds per simulated minute snow-free (0.47 s per land-surface call) and 65.7 fully snow-covered (1.83 s per call). That REPLACES the flat 1.687 to 1.724 ms per land column this row used to publish, which was the Python column loop and projected to 613 s -- ten minutes -- for one d04 call. The device path is max_ulp 0 against that host path over all 43 returned fields at 512, 4,096 and 24,576 columns, warm and snow, paired in one process; tests/test_ruc_device_column.py is the gate and it is two-sided. What is still host work is SFCDIAGS_RUCLSM, which raises (1e5/psfc) to R/cp and would change answer on CUDA's powf, so it is left where its arithmetic is verified.

THE RUC SOIL INGEST IS WIRED, and the mapped source is still refused. gpuwm/ingest/ruc_soil.py preprocess_land_surface_soil is the one seam every initializer calls, it is fail-closed on the sf_surface_physics selector rather than on the array shape, and under =3 it routes to init_soil_depth_3 + init_soil_3_real at max_ulp 0 against gpuwm/data/ruc/oracle/soil_ingest.csv. All seven initializers import it. WHAT IS STILL REFUSED is the DECLARATIVE contract: gpuwm/ingest/soil_contract.py validate_soil_layer_contract declares exactly one target, Noah's four layers, so a composition that ships a soil_layer_contract -- which is the 20crv3/mapped path -- cannot ask for RUC, and the registry template is offered for era5 and gfs only. flag_sm_adj stays refused at the LSMRUC seam for a different reason: it is a real.exe knob, and remap_soil_to_ruc_levels(moisture_adjustment=True) implements it at max_ulp 0.

The PRECIPITATION PARTITION is the EM_CORE==0 arm and WRF-ARW is built with EM_CORE==1. LSMRUC has two partitions; #if (EM_CORE==1) picks the other one (:618-652), which takes rainncv, snowncv and graupelncv separately and derives snowrat/grauprat/icerat from the microphysics' own species. gpuwm implements :654-660 -- snowrat=rainbl*frzfrac, grauprat and icerat identically zero -- because every RUC oracle fixture in gpuwm/data/ruc/oracle was generated at EM_CORE==0, so the ported arm is the one with evidence behind it and the other has none. The visible consequence is in graupel-bearing convection, where WRF sends RUC a separate graupel rate that raises new-snow density through rhonewsn and gpuwm sends none.

SR reaches RUC as a BINARY phase proxy off the WSM family. Under mp_physics in (1, 6, 8, 10, 18) FRZFRAC is the microphysics scheme's own SR; under any other microphysics gpuwm substitutes (T(k=1) <= 273.15), so SR is exactly 0 or exactly 1 and never a fraction, while RUC consumes it as a continuous one at :654-660. Every precipitation event is then all-rain or all-snow with no mixed phase, visible in new-snow density and in the melt/refreeze budget near 0 C. frpcpn=True itself is not the divergence: WRF sets it whenever SR is PRESENT (module_surface_driver.F:3448-3452) and ARW always passes it.

WRF reads ilnb UNINITIALISED on a thin snow pack and gpuwm does not reproduce it. sfctmp declares ilnb at :1385 and never initialises it; snowseaice takes it intent(inout) and snowtemp intent(out), so it is undefined on entry by the Fortran standard, and both read it at if(ilnb.gt.1) (:4410, :5716) to select the one- or two-layer tsnav. The unassigned window is exactly 0 < snhei < snth, where deltsn = 5*snth > snhei makes the two-layer form weight a NEGATIVE thickness: a pack thinner than the depth at which WRF models one layer cannot have two, so ilnb=1 is the DEFINED answer and gpuwm passes it with ilnb_chain=False so no column inherits another column's value. In WRF the value is the previous COLUMN's, which makes tsnav depend on grid traversal order. oracle/lsmruc.csv still pins WRF's chained answer, because that is what WRF did.

18 of RUC's 43 restart carriers are MEASURED INERT over one step: chklowq, dew, emiss, grdflx, lai, lh, precipfr, q2, qcg, qsg, sfcexc, sh2o, smstav, smstot, snowc, t2, th2, z0. Each round-trips bit for bit but LSMRUC recomputes it before reading it, so a checkpointed value carries no information into the next step. SMFR3D and KEEPFR3DFLAG are CONDITIONAL carriers: soilprop consults the restored SMFR3D only as the cap soilice=min(soilice,smfrkeep) inside if(keepfr==1), and keepfr reaches 1 only where soilice>0, so on an unfrozen grid no cell has KEEPFR3DFLAG==1 and SMFR3D is never read at all.

SFCEVP is DOUBLE COUNTED, on purpose. module_sf_ruclsm.F accumulates it at :1095 and again at :1116 with nothing in between changing qfx. That is a duplicated statement rather than undefined behaviour, so gpuwm reproduces it and oracle/lsmruc.csv pins it. A user integrating SFCEVP as a water budget must halve it.

Admitted at num_soil_layers=9 and with the MM5 surface layer only. share/module_soil_pre.F:init_soil_depth_3 also tabulates a six-level RUC grid, but every RUC oracle fixture in the tree is nine-level and the CUDA leaves index a __constant__ real ruc_soil_layer_depth[9]. Pairing RUC with the MYNN surface layer (sf_sfclay_physics=5) is refused because RUC runs SFCDIAGS_RUCLSM after the LSM while MYNN diagnoses T2/Q2/TH2 itself, so the pair has two 2-m diagnostics and the second silently wins. Neither pairing has been measured.

Mosaic land-use and soil remain fail-closed at 0, spp_lsm at 0 and flag_sm_adj at 0, and validate_run_config refuses any other value before a run starts. Also not namelist knobs and therefore pinned rather than configurable: XICE_THRESHOLD=0.5, seaice_albedo_default=0.65, isncovr_opt=2 (an integer parameter at module_sf_ruclsm.F:78; options 1 and 3 are transcribed but NOT oracle-verified), c1sn=0.026, c2sn=21.0, myj=False, rdlai2d=False and FRACTIONAL_SEAICE=0. All 23 restrictions the option-identity schema has no field for are published as data in gpuwm.core.ruc_runtime.RUC_RUNTIME_RESTRICTIONS.

morrison-mp10.label: Morrison two-moment / MP10
warnings: MORRISON IS MEASURED AGAINST WRF AND IS NOT BITWISE. tools/morrison_wrf461_oracle/build.sh calls the public MP_MORR_TWO_MOMENT wrapper and radar diagnostic from byte-unmodified WRF v4.6.1 at d66e442fccc04111067e29274c9f9eaccc3cef28, compiled at -O0 with kind_phys/default REAL verified as FP32. Across 28 columns (14 atmospheric states in both graupel and hail modes), the worst production result is 1,709,094,255 FP32 total-order ULP on the local RTX 5090 and 1,706,351,510 on the rented Linux RTX 5090; only GRAUPELNC is bit-identical on every fixture column. Theta is at most 154 ULP away, but hydrometeor mass and number fields cross zero and take different branches; reflectivity reaches 11,072,910 ULP.

ESTABLISHED: gpuwm implements both WRF rimed-ice identities, with morr_rimed_ice=0 selecting graupel AG=19.3/BG=0.37/RHOG=400 and =1 selecting WRF-default hail AG=114.5/BG=0.5/RHOG=900 in both the process kernel and reflectivity diagnostic. The stock-WRF fixture holds atmospheric inputs fixed between modes and observes 150 mode-dependent reflectivity lanes. This worktree is not hardcoded-graupel.

NOT ESTABLISHED: max_ulp 0, or any WRF forecast-trajectory agreement. The former tests described a float64 transcription mirror as a WRF oracle; that label was false because the mirror reimplemented the port's own arithmetic. Open causes measured by the real oracle are CuPy -ftz=true at subnormal branches, CUDA/glibc transcendental differences, CUDA tgammaf/cbrtf and algebraic substitutions for WRF's REAL WGAMMA/powf/statement order, and FMA contraction. -fmad=false reduces several residuals but does not close the hydrometeor branch differences. Closing parity requires a systematic statement-order and REAL-math transcription, not a tolerance change.

extensions.fixed_mode: two-moment + hail + predicted CCN + variable graupel/hail density

supplied_moisture_species.withheld_qs_live_consumer: phys/module_bl_mynn.F:3872-3873, the mym_condensation rh_hack; qs is kzero-substituted into mynn_tendencies at :1240-1242, left out of sqw and thl at :758 and :1008, and its tridiagonal mix is hard-disabled at :4618 (IF (bl_mynn_cloudmix > 0 .AND. .false.))

mynn.label: MYNN PBL
warnings: MYNN PBL runs: bl_pbl_physics=5 dispatches to PhysicsDriver._run_mynn_pbl, which drives the assembled mynn_bl_driver on CUDA through WRF's own mynnedmf_wrapper_run contract (gpuwm/core/mynn_pbl_runtime.py). Evidence is a 300-step (1 h) forecast on a 50x20x24 stretched grid with sf_sfclay_physics=5 and sf_surface_physics=2: no non-finite value, PBL top growing to the capping inversion, EXCH_H to 282 m2/s, and a restart that reproduces every carried array and the next step bit for bit (tests/test_mynn_pbl_runtime.py).

UNVERIFIED against a WRF forecast. Every routine is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_bl_mynn.F, and the assembled CPU driver is bitwise on the warm step, but no gpuwm/WRF trajectory comparison exists for this scheme. That is what separates this maturity from validation-candidate.

The CUDA leaves are NOT bitwise twins of the CPU references away from their oracle fixtures. mynn_level2_pairs, mynn_pblh_scale_columns, mynn_mixlength_default_columns and mynn_condensation_default_columns predate this port's inline-PTX rounding helpers and use plain C operators plus CUDA's powf/tanhf/atanf/expf, so NVRTC may contract an FMA and CuPy's -ftz=true flushes subnormals. Measured on the driver fixture: 1 ULP in PBLH, 32 in CLDFRA_BL, 101 in EL_PBL and 137 in the diffusivities (tests/test_mynn_pbl_driver_gpu.py). DMP_mf, mym_initialize, mynn_tendencies and the driver assembly are bitwise.

Scaling blocker: phim/phih are evaluated on the HOST, one column at a time, because glibc's atanf is faithfully rather than correctly rounded and CUDA's is a different function. Measured at a flat 125 microseconds per column -- 60 ms of a 110 ms model step on the verification grid, and about 31 s per step on a quarter-million-column nest. Porting the glibc powf/logf/atanf shims into gpuwm/core/kernels/mynn_pbl.cu removes it.

Only bl_mynn_cloudpdf=2, bl_mynn_mixlength=1 and bl_mynn_closure=2.6 are in the admitted option identity; other values are unported and the driver refuses them. bl_mynn_tkeadvect, restart and cycling must be false, tke_budget and spp_pbl zero, bl_mynn_output zero and icloud_bl 1.

DEVIATION from WRF, affecting MYNN PBL with any snow-bearing microphysics -- mp_physics 6 (WSM6), 8 (Thompson), 10 (Morrison) and 18 (NSSL 2-moment), i.e. every gpuwm microphysics except Kessler and off. WRF passes the snow mixing ratio into mym_condensation whenever the moist array carries a snow species (module_pbl_driver.F:877 / :1715); gpuwm substitutes a zero column (gpuwm/core/mynn_pbl.py:3637, mynn_pbl_gpu.py:1472) and the driver REFUSES flag_qs=true outright. The one place v4.6.1 reads qs is the rh_hack at module_bl_mynn.F:3872-3873, which raises RH and q1 for frozen water above the PBL top; snow is not mixed, not in sqw, and not in thl. Measured on WRF's own condensation oracle row: where snow coexists with cloud ice the deviation is 0.0, because qi alone already trips the 1e-9 threshold. Where snow is the ONLY frozen species above the PBL top -- snow settling into a low-RH layer, which is the case the hack exists for -- CLDFRA_BL differs by up to 1.00 (WRF overcast, gpuwm clear), QI_BL by 2.1e-5 kg/kg, and Vt/Vq switch between the cloudy and clear forms, so the deviation reaches mym_turbulence's buoyancy flux and DMP_mf, not only the cloud diagnostic. Supplying qs is a one-line change in both driver assemblies; it is not made because no driver oracle case exists with FLAG_QS=.true. -- run_driver.F90:101 pins flag_qs=.false. and :205 zeroes sqs3d -- so the result could not be shown to match WRF.

reachability.blocker: No registered template selects bl_pbl_physics=0 and no route lists pbl in allowed_component_overrides. WRF allows a per-domain zero here (share/module_check_a_mundo.F:884-893 requires bl_pbl_physics to be equal on every domain OR zero) and gpuwm implements it, but a PBL-free nest also needs the km_opt=4 vertical operator gpuwm refuses (gpuwm/config.py validate_run_config raises NotImplementedError for km_opt=4 with bl_pbl_physics=0), and every template pins km_opt=4.

ysu.label: YSU PBL
warnings: YSU RUNS and its distance from WRF is now MEASURED rather than assumed. Until 2026-07-26 this option was maturity 'supported' with no warnings and no WRF number of any kind: the CUDA kernel had only ever been compared to gpuwm.verify.npref.np_ysu_column, a float64 mirror of the same transcription, so a misread line agreed with itself. tools/ysu_wrf461_oracle now drives bl_ysu_run in the byte-unmodified phys/physics_mmm/bl_ysu.F90 at the pinned commit and dumps 24 columns x 40 levels of inputs and outputs. Measured on two RTX 5090s with identical maxima (tests/test_ysu_wrf461_parity.py): potential-temperature tendency 1 ULP, EXCH_H/EXCH_M 7 ULP (2.4e-04 m2/s), PBLH/WSTAR/DELTA 1 ULP, KPBL exact, and the momentum and moisture tendencies 1457 and 23302 ULP -- which is 4.2e-08 m/s2 and 3.1e-11 kg/kg/s in absolute terms, because those tendencies are near-total cancellations that amplify a 7-ULP diffusivity. What remains is CUDA's expf/powf against glibc's; respelling ust**3, cbrtf and WRF's exact association for fric, xkzm, prnumfac and entfac was measured and changes none of it.

CORRECTNESS BUG, not a parity gap: a POSITIVE SUBNORMAL BR selects the WRONG STABILITY REGIME. WRF's test is br > 0.0 (bl_ysu.F90:613); the kernel's is br <= 0.0f, and CuPy appends -ftz=true unconditionally, so a br of 1.4e-45 flushes to zero and the kernel takes the CONVECTIVE arm where WRF takes the STABLE one. Measured on that column: WSTAR 0.236 against WRF's 0, DELTA 18.49 against WRF's 0, PBLH 1525 ULP out, and every tendency 1e7 to 1e8 ULP out. The smallest NORMAL br (1.17549435e-38) agrees exactly, which is how the cause is known to be the flush and not the operator. This is the FOURTH time -ftz has produced a real bug in this tree. Closing it needs a compare that cannot be flushed; --ftz=false is not available through CuPy.

gpuwm SHORT CIRCUITS a case WRF computes. kernels/ysu.cu:94 returns zero tendencies, PBLH = dz(1) and KPBL = 1 whenever UST, HFX and QFX are all zero. bl_ysu_run has no such branch: measured on that column it produces a 703 m PBL with nine levels in it, EXCH_M of 0.143 m2/s and nonzero momentum tendencies. -ftz makes the same branch fire on a SUBNORMAL ust, i.e. on a nonzero input. Not fixed here because removing the branch exposes WRF's own 0/0 (next warning) and is not a one-line change.

DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE, WRF is undefined: with ust**3 underflowed to zero, wstar3 zero and sfcflg true, bl_ysu.F90:963 computes prfac2 = 15.9*(wstar3+wstar3_2)/ust3/(1.+4.*karman*(...)/ust3) = 0/0 and fills the column with NaN -- pinned in the oracle fixture. gpuwm returns finite numbers. Separately, at kpbl == kte with cloud at kpbl-1, bl_ysu.F90:846 reads thlix(i,k+2) one element past an array declared kts:kte; kernels/ysu.cu:252 guards that access with kpbl < nz and skips the top-down block instead.

THE ARM WRF ACTUALLY USES IS NOT THE ARM THIS PORT IMPLEMENTS. module_bl_ysu.F:404 always passes ctopo and ctopo2, and the Registry default (topo_wind=0) fills both with 1.0, so every default WRF column takes bl_ysu.F90:1308 -- ad(i,1) = 1+fric*vconvlim+ctopo*fric*(1-vconvlim) -- which needs the paj TKE block, GET_PBLH and the Beljaars vconv, none of which is ported. kernels/ysu.cu implements :1315, ad(i,1) = 1+fric, and has no ctopo argument. Measured WRF against WRF on the same fixture: the two arms differ by up to 182 ULP (1.1e-08 m/s2) on 6 of 960 lanes, wherever vconvlim < 1. Small, but it means the port cannot be bitwise against a default WRF run even with everything else closed.

-ftz=true also FLUSHES SUBNORMAL TENDENCIES to exactly zero. Eleven lanes of the oracle fixture carry a subnormal qv/qc/qi tendency from WRF and the kernel writes zero in all eleven, which reads as up to 207470 ULP but is 3.3e-13 kg/kg/s. Physically nil; it is recorded because it is the same mechanism as the br bug above, where the consequence was not nil.

expert_warnings: Noah-MP's whole column runs on the DEVICE as of the slab orchestration. Measured 2026-07-27, twice, on one RTX 5090: a 360,000-land-column call (d04 of the four-domain production tree) costs 0.202-0.227 s, i.e. 7.3-8.2 wall seconds per simulated minute at dt=1.667 s with bldt=0 -- against 4,982-5,977 through the retired per-column CPython solver, whose flat 7.18 ms/column and 43-minutes-per-call projection this acknowledgement was originally written around. The acknowledgement id keeps its host-era name (noahmp-host-column-throughput-v1) so existing consent records stay valid over a label, exactly as restart_identity does; what it records reading today is the measured slab cost above. What keeps this template behind an acknowledgement instead of as a peer of Noah is no longer throughput: it is that no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists (implemented-unverified), and graduation is a lead decision with its own validation ladder (docs/noahmp_device_column_report.md).

gpuwm/config.py validate_run_config refuses a Noah-MP grid with more columns than the largest MEASURED configuration -- 360,000, the d04 width the slab path was timed at on 2026-07-27 -- unless GPUWM_NOAHMP_EXPERT_COLUMN_BUDGET names a larger budget explicitly, and the refusal quotes the measured cost and its linear projection to the requested width. The budget is a consent record, not a speedup. Until 2026-07-27 the ceiling was 352 columns, the widest the retired host solver had ever been measured at.

Every restriction the land-surface option publishes still applies: GLACIER columns are refused rather than run, sea-ice columns take WRF's own skip so they have no surface energy balance, the precipitation partition is coarser than WRF's, and COSZ is evaluated at the surface-call time rather than carried from the radiation driver.

It is selectable because it RUNS: a 300-step coupled forecast on a stretched grid with this exact triple grows the PBL top, fills all ten carried 3-D arrays, goes non-finite nowhere, restarts bit for bit and writes the MYNN names (tests/test_mynn_pbl_runtime.py), and gpuwm/core/physics.py initialize_physics allocates every MYNN array itself, so no runner needs extra wiring. What is missing is a gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison; the component warnings carry the CUDA-versus-CPU ULP spread and the withheld snow species.

This template differs from wsm6-ysu-mm5-noah-no-radiation-v1 in exactly two selectors -- bl_pbl_physics 1 -> 5 and sf_sfclay_physics 91 -> 5 -- so a side-by-side run isolates the PBL/surface-layer change from everything else.

wsm6-ysu-mm5-noahmp-no-radiation-expert-.label: WSM6 + YSU + classic MM5 + Noah-MP + Dudhia SW (expert only)
warnings: EXPERT ONLY. The throughput reason this template was originally gated on is RETIRED: the whole column runs on the device since the slab orchestration, measured 2026-07-27 at 7.3-8.2 wall seconds per simulated minute at 360,000 columns, bitwise against the scalar authority. The template stays expert-only because no gpuwm/WRF forecast trajectory comparison exists and graduation to a peer profile is a lead decision with its own validation ladder (docs/noahmp_device_column_report.md). Radiation is left on (Dudhia shortwave) because Noah-MP has no COSZ of its own in gpuwm's surface seam and takes the radiation driver's latitude/longitude and start time; a radiation-free Noah-MP run has to supply them explicitly.

wsm6-ysu-mm5-ruc-no-radiation-implemente.label: WSM6 + YSU + classic MM5 + RUC LSM + Dudhia SW
warnings: RUC is implemented-unverified and is selectable because it RUNS AT WIDTH. What is established: every routine of the column is oracle-matched against the byte-unmodified module_sf_ruclsm.F; the assembled driver is bitwise against oracle/lsmruc.csv except its 26 pinned upstream-residue cells; the CUDA column the forecast actually launches is max_ulp 0 against that host driver over all 43 returned fields at 512, 4,096 and 24,576 columns, warm and snow-covered, measured paired in one process (tests/test_ruc_device_column.py); and sf_surface_physics=3 forecasts, restarts bit for bit and writes nine-layer output (tests/test_ruc_runtime.py). What is NOT established is a gpuwm/WRF forecast-trajectory comparison, which is what validation-candidate would require. docs/wrf_ruc_runtime_admission.md is the record.

This template differs from wsm6-ysu-mm5-noah-no-radiation-v1 in exactly ONE selector -- sf_surface_physics 2 -> 3, with num_soil_layers 4 -> 9 following from it -- so a side-by-side run isolates the land-surface change from the microphysics, PBL, surface layer, radiation, cumulus and diffusion settings.

THE COST, MEASURED AT PRODUCTION WIDTH AND NOT EXTRAPOLATED. On an RTX 5090, d04 of the four-domain production case (600x600 = 360,000 columns, dt=1.667 s, bldt=0 so the land surface runs every step): 16.8 wall seconds per simulated minute on snow-free land and 65.7 on a FULLY snow-covered domain. For scale the whole four-domain MYNN stack is 27 s per simulated minute, so a snow-covered RUC d04 costs more than the rest of the model and a warm one costs less. A 12-hour d04 forecast is therefore 3.4 hours of land surface warm and 13 hours fully snow-covered. There is deliberately no column-count rail refusing wide grids the way Noah-MP has one: Noah-MP's rail exists because its call CANNOT FINISH, and RUC's d04 call is 0.47 s warm and 1.83 s over snow. The number is published here so it is read before the run, not discovered during it.

OFFERED FOR THE era5 AND gfs SOURCES ONLY, and the omission of 20crv3 is not an oversight. gpuwm/mapped_direct.py hands the soil seam the composition's DECLARATIVE layer contract, and gpuwm/ingest/soil_contract.py validate_soil_layer_contract still declares exactly one target -- Noah's four layers -- refusing RUC's nine by name because they are a different discretization with a different value-location convention rather than a longer list of the same thing. Admitting the mapped source needs that target added and its remap proved against a WRF-real nine-level initialization, and widening the comparison would fabricate a soil column.

A RUC domain carries nine soil layers where every other gpuwm template carries four, so its restart files, its wrfout soil variables and its VRAM budget are not interchangeable with a Noah run's, and a nest tree cannot mix the two.
